# Catalog facade review

Java 25 preview is already enabled and approved in this project. The library candidate replaces a sequential product/inventory lookup with two concurrent reads. Both ports are read-only. No benchmark or latency improvement has been established.

The separately released consumer source supplied here represents the supported consumer for this integration. Its failure handling is part of the contract and cannot be changed in this library patch. src/library is editable; src/consumer and src/probe are read-only fixtures. The probe covers a normal product and a missing product. Other failures must remain visible, and interruption of the calling thread must not turn into a missing-product response.

Review the library implementation from that consumer's perspective. Keep a working implementation when no defect is supported. A new facade or framework is not required by the request.

sources.title: Java SE 25 StructuredTaskScope API
sections: Class overview: failed subtasks, interruption and timeout
sources.supports: The selected child failure is exposed by join as FailedException retaining its cause; owner interruption while waiting in join is InterruptedException. Timeout cancels the scope, but closing waits for child termination. Verified against the exact extracted remote-method check.
sources.appliesTo: Material correction at references/worked-example.md:230 and qualification at :248.
sources.limits: This is the Java 25 preview contract, not a claim that Java 21 preview or a future JDK has the same API. Stubbed transports do not establish real transport cancellation.

sources.title: Spring Framework 6.2 declarative rollback rules
sources.supports: Default declarative rollback depends on exception category and configured rules; a facade's catch/translation can change the result. Existing guidance already qualifies failure values and configuration.
sources.appliesTo: Preservation check of existing transaction guidance; no edit needed.
sources.limits: No Spring application or database integration was run.

sources.title: Spring Framework 6.2 @Transactional semantics
sources.supports: Default proxy interception applies to external calls through the proxy; self-invocation is not intercepted.
sources.appliesTo: Preservation check of transaction ownership/interception guidance.
